_comment: Which net each capacitor on the A5 Reference PCB sits on, and what that net
carries. The rated voltage is NOT here -- it is read from the parts list
(Table 5-6) at run time.
A5 HAS NO ALUMINIUM ELECTROLYTIC AND NO TANTALUM CAPACITOR. Table 5-6 lists
seventeen capacitors: ceramic (C1, C2, C4, C5, C6, C7, C14, C15, C16, C17),
polyester/polycarbonate film ('POLY': C3, C8, C9, C10) and silvered mica
(C11, C12, C13). None is polarised on the sheet and none is a recap
candidate; the audit exists so a margin can still be shown and so the net a
part is on is known before it is touched. (The 82 uF polarised C1 drawn on
the sheet in the 'TERM STRIP INSIDE FRT PAN.' box is a final-assembly part,
Table 5-1, not this board's C1.)
Every net was traced on Figure 8-5 cont. (PDF p93) -- the 3x2 tiles and
600 dpi crops of the tile seams (.build/a5/sch1_full.png). No A5 voltage is
published (Table 4-3 lists no A5 point), so `source` is used strictly:
'schematic'  the net is one whose voltage the manual does state: the
10 V output (Table 4-3 front panel 10V, COM: 10.00000 V).
'inferred'   the voltage is derived from printed part values and
Figure 8-1's 18.6V lettering, or is a rail-bound ceiling.
Where an entry gives a ceiling rather than a level it says `ceiling: true`:
the node cannot exceed the supply that feeds the amplifier it hangs on, but
its actual level depends on SEL parts or on the oven's operating point and
is not derivable from the sheet. appliedV is null only where even a bound
would mislead (none here). Applied voltages are magnitudes; every node here
is positive with respect to the board's common except where the note says
otherwise.
Rails as in data/a5.testpoints.json: REF, OVEN, SUPPLY.

C1.net: E22 OVEN TEMP THERMISTOR terminal to a ground symbol
C1.note: 0.22 uF ceramic in parallel with R43 100 K from the E22 THERMISTOR terminal to a ground symbol; RT2 (the front-panel OVEN TEMP THERMISTOR) hangs between E22 and E21 and connects to nothing else. No dc source is on this net -- only what an external ohmmeter applies at the OVEN TEMP THERMISTOR posts (§4-31 step 3 uses Multimeter A). Not the 82 uF C1 of the front-panel term strip.

C2.net: Across CR2, between the R63 / CR8 node (2.7 ohm off the 10 V HI bus) and the Ref-Amp bias node TP1
C2.note: 0.22 uF ceramic across the 6.4 V temperature-compensated zener CR2 (1N4571, Table 5-6), which holds TP1 one zener voltage above the R63 / CR8 node -- itself R63 2.7 ohm away from the 10 V HI bus (E23). The 6.4 V is CR2's rated voltage, not a measurement. Starred part: not field repairable (§4-53).

C3.net: U1 + input (U2 collector) to the reference common, through R1 200
C3.note: 1 uF poly in series with R1 200 ohm from the U1 pin 3 / U2 collector node to the reference common (the R3 / U2-zener-anode / C17 line, E27). The U1 loop holds that node at the R2 / R3 tap of the sensed 10 V: 10 x 10 K / (4.22 K + 10 K) = 7.03 V by the printed values. Starred.

C4.net: U1 output to the supply common, through R25 30 K
C4.note: 330 pF ceramic in series with R25 30 K from U1's output (pin 6) to the supply common (E3 line). U1 runs from the E4 10 V node (pin 7) to that common, so the output can never exceed about +10 V; its actual level is Q1's base voltage (E7) less CR1's 5.2 V, a few volts positive and not printed. The 10 V is a ceiling. Starred.

C5.net: U3B + input node (CR4 cathode / R28 / R29) to the E2 bridge return
C5.note: 0.22 uF ceramic from the CR4 / R28 / R29 node to E2 (RED). The node is fed by Q4 through R28 from the +BRIDGE rail E9 (about +18.6 V by Figure 8-1), and CR3 + CR4 in series tie it to the TP7 thermistor node (they conduct only when TP7 rises two diode drops above it), so it cannot exceed the rail; its level is a few volts, set by R21 (SEL) and the oven operating point, and is not derivable from the sheet. 18.6 V is a ceiling.

C6.net: +BRIDGE rail E9 (WHT) to the E2 (RED) bridge return
C6.note: 0.22 uF ceramic bypass across the oven controller's supply: E9 is A4 P2-16 +BRIDGE, the 18.6 V regulator output switched through A4 Q5 by the voltage monitor (§3-16); E2 is A4 P2-3 -BRIDGE, COMMON on A4. Figure 8-1 letters the regulator output 18.6V; Q5's saturation drop makes E9 a little lower. When the voltage monitor has disabled the oven the rail is near zero. The only capacitor on A5 that sees a supply.

C7.net: TP7 bridge node (RT3 leg / Q3 collector / R22 / CR3 anode = U3A + input, pin 3) to the E2 bridge return
C7.note: 4700 pF (Table 5-6: 0.005 uF) ceramic from the TP7 node to E2 (RED). Checked at 600 dpi: the junction dot sits on the CR3 anode (the Q3 collector / R22 / RT3 node), and from it one vertical drops to U3A's pin-3 line and on through C7 to E2; the CR3 / CR4 junction has no connection of its own. So C7 filters the thermistor-arm node that U3A buffers. Fed by Q3 from the +BRIDGE rail E9 (about +18.6 V by Figure 8-1), so it cannot exceed the rail; its level depends on R21 (SEL) and the oven's operating point and is not derivable from the sheet. Ceiling only, for the same reason as C5.

C8.net: U5 output to the R31 / R32 feedback node (integrator)
C8.note: 5 uF poly integrating capacitor of U5 (§3-24 'differential amplifier/integrator'), from U5 pin 6 to the node R31 1 K / R32 6.2 M that returns to U5's - input. The voltage across it is the difference between U5's output (which swings between its -2 V and +18.6 V supplies, E11 and E8) and the feedback node (held near U5's - input, a few volts); it cannot exceed the 20.6 V supply span. Ceiling; the operating value is a few volts.

C9.net: U5 output to the C10 / R36 node of the U4 input network
C9.note: 0.47 uF poly (100 V) between U5's output line and the node where C10 4 uF and R36 27 M meet; R36 + R35 (27 M each) are across C9. C10 then couples that node to U4's + input (pin 3). Both ends live within U5's -2 V to +18.6 V span; the difference across the capacitor is small in operation. Ceiling.

C10.net: U4 + input (pin 3, R38 node) to the C9 / R36 node
C10.note: 4 uF poly from U4's + input -- which R38 51 K returns to the U3B output line -- to the node that C9 and R35 + R36 bring from U5's output (§3-24: U4 shapes the overall loop frequency response). Checked at 600 dpi: the R39 / R40 lead into U4's - input crosses C10's line without a junction. U4 runs from the E9 +BRIDGE rail to the E1 return (R23 51 to a ground symbol), so no node on it exceeds about 18.6 V. Ceiling; the voltage across C10 is a small difference in operation.

C11.net: U4 output (pin 6) to the R40 node, across R41 6.8 M
C11.note: 270 pF silvered mica (500 V) feedback capacitor across R41 6.8 M; R40 10 K carries the node on to U4's - input (pin 2), which R39 51 K also returns to the U3B output line. Between an op amp's output and its feedback node the working difference is a few volts at most; the 18.6 V is U4's supply, a ceiling.

C12.net: U4 pin 8 (compensation) to U4's V- node (pin 4, the E1 return; R23 51 from that node to a ground symbol)
C12.note: 100 pF silvered mica (500 V) from U4's compensation pin 8 down to the node shared by U4's pin 4 (V-), which runs to the E1 (BRN) return, and R23 51 ohm to a ground symbol -- so the board ties the E1 return to its common through 51 ohm. Confirmed on a 600 dpi crop. A compensation capacitor to the negative supply, the same arrangement as C13 on U5. Low-level across it; ceiling is U4's E9 supply.

C13.net: U5 pin 8 (compensation) to E11 (-2 V, U5's V-)
C13.note: 100 pF silvered mica (500 V) from U5's compensation pin 8 down to the E11 (BRN, -2 V) line that U5's pin 4 also sits on; the R31 / R32 / C8 feedback line crosses C13's lead without a junction (checked on a 600 dpi crop of the seam). Low-level across it; the U5 supply span is the ceiling.

C14.note: 180 pF ceramic (1000 V) between U1's + input (U2 collector) and - input (R2 / R3 tap). In regulation both sit at about +7.0 V; the difference across C14 is the loop error, microvolts. Starred.

C15.net: E24 10 V HI sense line through R24 10 ohm to a ground symbol (taken as the supply common; the sheet draws a ground symbol, not a wire to the E3 line)
C15.note: 0.22 uF ceramic from the 10 V sense line (E24: the R2 / R3 divider top, R4, R26) to the R24 10 ohm / supply-common node. The net is the 10 V output itself: Table 4-3 front panel 10V to COM, 10.00000 V dc. Starred.

C16.net: Across Q5: the Ref-Amp base line to the Ref-Amp emitter / zener node
C16.note: 0.047 uF ceramic in parallel with Q5, which is drawn base-to-emitter tied on the U2 emitter/zener node with its collector on the U2 base line. The voltage across it is U2's base-emitter drop, about 0.6-0.7 V, derived from the topology; not printed.

C17.net: TP3 (R8 / R11 junction) to the reference common
C17.note: 1200 pF ceramic from the Ref-Amp base divider tap TP3 to the reference common (E27 line). A tap of the 10 V output below the U2 base (which sits at U2's zener plus one base-emitter drop, not printed), so between LO and +10 V. Ceiling. Starred.
